subject: Re: which state fires, Stop, the log
body: One state in the MVP, so a detection fires that state (with three states later, it's the targetStateId picked on Live). Yes: the app shows Stop for the whole rep and calls your stop(reason). Yes: the app stores the RepSession log in localStorage and passes it to status() and progress(). The Rep screen renders from your onStep events, replaying the person's own step order with the driver submodalities as spoken instructions (D-coord-012). Use host.clock and host.speech from the ModuleHost (D-experience-005).
